title: Legal Register (Extract)
subtitle: Health and safety legislation that applies to the Epping cold store, reviewed 1 September 2026

blocks.p: This register lists the health and safety legislation that applies to **Bokmakierie Cold Storage (Pty) Ltd**, 14 Kiewiet Road, Epping Industria, Cape Town: a cold store with an ammonia refrigeration plant, forklift operations, a loading dock for 22 trucks a day and 64 employees. It shows, for each instrument, what it asks of us in plain words, why it applies, its verification status, the owner who keeps our evidence current, and when the entry was last reviewed and is next due for review.

The status comes from Care Net's legislation register on the day of our review. **Awaiting verification for health and safety provisions** means Care Net has not yet completed its checks of that instrument's health and safety provisions; we keep our evidence for the duty in the meantime and do not treat the entry as confirmed. When the status changes, the owner updates the entry and the evidence list.

cols: What it asks of us, and why it applies
rows: The OHS Act
A safe workplace without risk to health: assess risks, inform and train employees, appoint people in writing, keep a copy of the Act on site. **Applies:** we employ people.
Awaiting verification for health and safety provisions
Nomvula Dlamini, Health and Safety Manager
The OHS Act, section 16(2) and section 37(2)

Assign the chief executive's duties in writing; agree in writing with every contractor how it will keep to the Act on our premises. **Applies:** duties assigned to the Operations Director; refrigeration and cleaning contractors.
Awaiting verification for health and safety provisions
Andre Jacobs, Operations Director
COIDA
Register with the Compensation Fund, keep a current letter of good standing, report injuries on duty and occupational diseases. **Applies:** we employ people.
Awaiting verification for health and safety provisions
Fatima Isaacs, Human Resources Manager
The Hazardous Chemical Agents Regulations
Assess and control exposure, keep safety data sheets, train exposed employees, keep records. **Applies:** ammonia refrigeration plant; cleaning chemicals.
Awaiting verification for health and safety provisions
Nomvula Dlamini, Health and Safety Manager
Rules under the OHS Act for electrical installations and machinery

Keep the electrical installation certified, guard and maintain machinery, have lifting equipment and forklifts inspected by competent people. **Applies:** plant, conveyors, dock levellers, 11 forklifts.
Awaiting verification for health and safety provisions
Werner Botha, Maintenance Manager
The Construction Regulations, 2014
Client duties when we commission building work, including a health and safety specification and approving the contractor's plan. **Applies:** from the chamber six extension planned for 2027.
Awaiting verification for health and safety provisions
Andre Jacobs, Operations Director
The Hazardous Biological Agents Regulations; the Lead Regulations
**Not applicable:** we store sealed, packaged product and do no work with lead. Checked at every review.
Awaiting verification for health and safety provisions
Nomvula Dlamini, Health and Safety Manager

numbered: The Health and Safety Manager reviews this register every month, and also whenever a new activity, substance, site or contractor is introduced, or Care Net's legislation register shows a change.
Each owner confirms at the review that the evidence for their entries is current and filed in the right section of the Health and Safety File.
The register is version controlled: this is version 7, replacing version 6 of 3 August 2026. Superseded versions are kept in the File archive.
